title: Spicy Spanish Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken dish with a blend of Indian and Spanish spices. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Spanish herb mix to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin powder and cayenne pepper (if using) to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken back to the skillet and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with chopped cilantro (if using) and a side of light cream for serving.
